question: Compare the FY24 dividend payout ratio of Coca-Cola (KO) to that of its competitors and rank in order from highest to lowest.
model_answer:
Using **FY2024 declared dividends per share ÷ FY2024 diluted GAAP EPS**, Coca-Cola and its closest direct peers rank as follows:

| Rank | Company | Ticker | FY24 DPS | FY24 diluted EPS | Payout ratio |
|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Keurig Dr Pepper | KDP | $0.89 | $1.05 | **84.8%** |
| 2 | **Coca-Cola** | **KO** | **$1.94** | **$2.46** | **78.9%** |
| 3 | PepsiCo | PEP | $5.33 | $6.95 | **76.7%** |
| 4 | Monster Beverage | MNST | $0.00 | $0.75 | **0.0%** |

**Bottom line:** Coca-Cola’s FY24 payout ratio was **78.9%**, second-highest in this peer group—about **2.2 percentage points above PepsiCo** and **5.9 points below Keurig Dr Pepper**. Monster pays no dividend.

**Important caveat:** KDP’s GAAP EPS was depressed by impairment and other charges. On **adjusted/comparable EPS**, the ranking changes:

- **KO:** $1.94 / $2.88 ≈ **67.4%**
- **PEP:** $5.33 / $8.16 ≈ **65.3%**
- **KDP:** $0.89 / $1.92 ≈ **46.4%**
- **MNST:** **0.0%**

So on a headline GAAP basis: **KDP > KO > PEP > MNST**. On an adjusted-earnings basis: **KO > PEP > KDP > MNST**.

Sources: [KO 2024 results/10-K](https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1128/coca-cola-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results), [PEP 2024 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/pep-20241228.htm), [KDP 2024 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1418135/000141813525000013/kdp-20241231.htm), [MNST 2024 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/865752/000141057825000248/mnst-20241231x10k.htm).
judge_reason: Only KO matches; KDP and PEP are different precise values, KHC and SJM are omitted, and the conflicting stated ratios trigger contradiction.
